name: wt-rules-on-demand
description: EXPERIMENTAL. Deliver frontmatter-triggered rules at matching prompts and tool calls.

enabled.title: Enable on-demand rule delivery
enabled.description: Activate on-demand rule delivery; otherwise hooks pass through unchanged.

time_reserve.title: Allow time-based re-serving
time_reserve.description: Opt into time-based re-serving within one context instead of serving each rule once.

max_per_context.title: Maximum deliveries per context when time reserve is on
max_per_context.description: Maximum deliveries per rule and context only when time_reserve is enabled; otherwise the cap is one.
